name: onlyoffice-claude-bridge-mcp
description: MCP server that lets Claude edit the document open in OnlyOffice through the Claude Bridge plugin.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/server.mjs --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --legal-comments=none
